name: Raymond Lifestyle Limited
summary: Raymond Lifestyle Limited is an Indian maker and retailer of branded apparel, with labels such as Raymond, Park Avenue, ColorPlus, Parx and Ethnix. It also supplies textiles, including suiting fabric sold as Raymond Fine Fabrics and cotton and linen shirting, and sells suits, blazers, trousers, denim and shirts. Home furnishings like bedsheets and towels carry the Raymond Home name.
